stories.title: Sensex and Nifty rally on foreign investment
stories.summary: Indian equity markets rose on Tuesday, with the Sensex and Nifty gaining about 10 percent in November. The rally is supported by $9.53 billion in foreign portfolio investor inflows and resilient corporate earnings. The indices climbed despite overnight losses on Wall Street and weakness in Asian markets.

stories.title: Bank Nifty hits record high as markets climb
stories.summary: The Bank Nifty reached an all-time high on Tuesday, leading broad-based gains that pushed the Nifty50 above 25,400. Institutional buying and easing crude oil prices helped the Sensex rise 640 points. ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, and SBI were the primary contributors to the banking index's record performance.

stories.title: Sensex gains 800 points as banking stocks lead
stories.summary: Indian benchmark indices rallied nearly 1 percent on Tuesday, with the Sensex hitting an intraday high of 82,897. Banking stocks led the charge, including ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, and State Bank of India. The gains were attributed to easing crude oil prices and strong foreign investor inflows.

stories.title: Dalal Street extends gains as foreign investors return
stories.summary: The Sensex surged over 600 points on Tuesday, marking a second consecutive session of gains. Foreign investor buying, lower crude oil prices, and a rally in banking stocks are credited with lifting the market. Global equities remain under pressure due to ongoing concerns regarding the artificial intelligence sector.

stories.title: Sensex rises 750 points on banking sector buying
stories.summary: The Sensex rose 750 points on Tuesday, supported by buying in bank shares and easing crude oil prices. The Nifty remained near 25,500, maintaining a bullish trend. Foreign institutional investor activity remains a key driver for the market as it continues to build on recent monthly gains.

stories.title: Sensex climbs 0.9 percent led by large caps
stories.summary: The Sensex gained 732 points on Tuesday, reaching 82,837. The index has surged 11.25 percent over the past three weeks, leaving it 4.01 percent below its 52-week high. While the index is trading above its 50-day moving average, the longer-term trend remains below the 200-day moving average.

stories.title: Indian markets rise on foreign inflows
stories.summary: Indian benchmarks advanced on Tuesday, bucking the trend of weakness across Asian markets. Foreign institutional investors bought 4,864.68 crore rupees of equities on Monday, while Brent crude fell below $92 a barrel. The inflows and softer oil prices helped domestic markets withstand broader global selling pressure.

stories.title: Indian markets show resilience as foreign funds flow in
stories.summary: Indian indices rose on Tuesday, driven by foreign institutional investor inflows and a decline in crude oil prices. The market demonstrated resilience against global downturns, supported by improved macroeconomic indicators and corporate earnings. Major gainers included InterGlobe Aviation as the rally extended through the mid-session.

stories.title: Indian markets extend rally as foreign inflows offset global worries: Sensex up 280+ points - The Week
Sensex and Nifty advance on cooling crude prices
stories.summary: The Sensex and Nifty traded higher on Tuesday, helped by steady foreign fund inflows and cooling crude oil prices. The 30-share BSE Sensex advanced 108 points in early trade before extending gains. The market continues to reflect investor appetite for domestic equities despite external global market volatility.

stories.title: Sensex rises 249 points, Nifty crosses 25,350 on foreign fund inflows, lower crude oil prices - Telegraph India
Tech sell-off deepens as Nvidia results loom
stories.summary: Investors are reacting to tighter US chip export controls and a potential slowdown in the build-out of artificial intelligence data centers. The uncertainty comes as the market prepares for upcoming financial results from Nvidia, which has recently faced significant volatility and leadership challenges.

stories.title: Tech stocks drag equity futures lower ahead of Fed remarks. - CME Group
Wall Street falls as Nvidia leads tech sell-off
stories.summary: The S&P 500 fell 1.9 percent and the Nasdaq dropped 2.5 percent on Monday, led by declines in artificial intelligence companies. Nvidia sank 4.1 percent following reports regarding CEO Jensen Huang. The company has lost $735 billion in market value since the scandal regarding his leadership erupted.

stories.title: Asian Stocks Fall as U.S. Moves to Tighten Chip Curbs - WSJ
Nasdaq 100 sinks as AI trade faces pressure
stories.summary: The Nasdaq 100 fell 2.7 percent on Monday as US chip stocks faced a fresh bout of selling pressure. The decline marks a gloomy start to a pivotal week for the artificial intelligence sector, which is currently testing the sustainability of its recent bull market rally.

stories.title: Global stocks fall ahead of Nvidia earnings
stories.summary: Global stock indexes fell on Monday, led by semiconductor shares. US chipmakers dropped 5.3 percent, while markets in South Korea and Taiwan declined by 3.6 percent and 6 percent respectively. The upcoming Nvidia earnings and Anthropic's market debut are expected to test the strength of the AI-fueled rally.

stories.title: US stocks fall as Nvidia-led sell-off pushes Nasdaq into correction
stories.summary: A broad selloff dragged US stocks lower on Monday as fallout from Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia CEO soured enthusiasm for AI stocks. The Nasdaq fell 2.5 percent, while the S&P 500 dropped 1.9 percent. The market is currently weighing AI-related gains against a rotation trade.

stories.title: Wall Street ends sharply lower on AI jitters ahead of Nvidia results, Anthropic IPO - Reuters
U.S. Stocks Extend Slide on Nvidia, China Fears - WSJ
Stocks slide to kick off major week for Wall Street
stories.summary: US markets closed lower Monday, led by declines in technology stocks associated with the artificial intelligence boom. The S&P 500 fell 1.9 percent and the Nasdaq Composite fell 2.5 percent. Shares of Nvidia dropped 4.1 percent, falling for the third consecutive day since Jensen Huang resigned.

stories.title: Wall Street tumbles as AI jitters hit tech stocks
stories.summary: A broad selloff dragged US stocks lower as fallout from Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia CEO soured enthusiasm for AI stocks. The Nasdaq suffered the steepest loss, tumbling 2.5 percent, as the Philadelphia SE Semiconductor Index weighed on the index. The SOX lost 5.3 percent.

stories.title: Stocks tumble on Wall St. as Nvidia leads another sell-off in tech firms
stories.summary: More drops for stocks in the artificial intelligence industry dragged the US market lower on Monday, led by Nvidia. The weakness helped knock the S&P 500 index 1.9 percent lower and pushed the Nasdaq composite index to a 2.5 percent loss. Nvidia sank 4.1 percent.

stories.title: Sebi sets up NSE chief Ashish Chauhan-led panel to review IPO, FPO, QIP norms
stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has set up a 10-member sub-group to review rules governing initial public offerings, follow-on public offerings, preferential issues and qualified institutional placements. The move is aimed at making it easier for companies to raise money from the capital market.

stories.title: RBI directs Tata Sons to meet NBFC listing rules
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India directed Tata Sons to comply with regulations for Upper Layer Non-Banking Financial Companies, including mandatory listing. The company was classified as an NBFC-UL in September 2022, requiring it to list within three years. The deadline expired on September 30, 2025.

stories.title: SEBI directs market intermediaries to update KYC, tax reporting systems
stories.summary: SEBI has asked registered intermediaries to comply with Rules 238 to 240 of the Income-tax Rules, 2026. The revised requirements cover financial accounts falling under the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act and Common Reporting Standard. Intermediaries must incorporate these reporting requirements into their customer onboarding and KYC frameworks.

stories.title: Tata Group stocks rally after RBI reiterates listing requirement for Tata Sons
stories.summary: Shares of several Tata Group companies rose on Tuesday after the Reserve Bank of India reiterated that Tata Sons must comply with regulations for upper-layer non-banking financial companies. Tata Chemicals led the gains, surging 9 percent. The rally followed a letter reinforcing the pressure to list.

stories.title: RBI files review petition in Yes Bank AT-1 bonds case
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India filed a review petition in the Supreme Court requesting a review of its October 15 decision that declared the write-off of 8,415 crore of YES Bank AT-1 bonds invalid. The bonds were written off during the bank's 2020 reconstruction plan.

stories.title: RBI reiterates listing requirement for Tata Sons amid growing differences - News Today | First with the news - News Toda
Tata group stocks rally after RBI nudges Tata Sons to comply with listing norms
stories.summary: Shares of Tata Group companies rallied on Tuesday after the RBI directed Tata Sons to adhere to regulations for upper-layer non-banking financial companies. These include the requirement for the holding company to list its shares. Tata Sons has been classified as an upper-layer NBFC since 2022.

stories.title: RBI tells Tata Sons to comply with listing rules
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has directed Tata Sons to comply with regulations governing upper-layer non-banking financial companies, explicitly including the requirement to list its shares. The communication, dated November 16, follows a request by the company seeking clarification on the regulations applicable to it.

stories.title: Banks seek longer ECL transition and review of provisioning norms
stories.summary: Banks have asked the Reserve Bank of India to review expected credit loss provisioning requirements and allow a longer transition ahead of the April 1, 2027 implementation date. Lenders cited potential capital impact and implementation challenges, seeking a transition spread over multiple years for the new model.

stories.title: RBI seeks review of Supreme Court verdict on Yes Bank AT1 bond write-off
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has filed a review petition challenging the October 15 judgment that set aside the decision to write off 8,415 crore of AT-1 bonds during YES Bank's 2020 restructuring. YES Bank has also asked the court to reconsider the judgment.

stories.title: RBI reiterates listing requirement for Tata Sons
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has reiterated that Tata Sons must comply with regulations applicable to non-banking financial companies classified in the Upper Layer, including the mandatory requirement to list on stock exchanges. The directive was issued in a letter to the company's chief financial officer.

stories.title: IndusInd Bank and Mastercard partner for cross-border payments
stories.summary: IndusInd Bank and Mastercard have launched a collaboration to streamline outbound cross-border payments using the Mastercard Move platform. The partnership targets remittances and education-related transfers to the US, UK, Europe, Canada and Australia, promising faster transactions with end-to-end visibility. IndusInd Bank shares rose 1.21 percent on the news.

stories.title: MapmyIndia integrates navigation with Zoho's Arattai
stories.summary: C.E. Info Systems has integrated its Mappls navigation app with Zoho's Arattai messaging platform. Users can now open shared locations in Arattai and access turn-by-turn directions within Mappls without switching applications. The feature provides routes, estimated travel time, distance and trip costs for Android and iOS users.

stories.title: UPI monthly transaction value hits record 31.53 lakh crore
stories.summary: India's Unified Payments Interface reached 31.53 lakh crore in transaction value during October 2026, the highest monthly figure recorded to date. The National Payments Corporation of India reported 25.47 billion transactions for the month, a 23 percent increase in volume compared to October 2025. Records are regular.

stories.title: Lenders move to reduce AI debt exposure
stories.summary: Lenders are offloading debt tied to data centres and chips as public opposition threatens to derail mega projects. The shift comes as banks seek to curb their exposure to the infrastructure required for large-scale artificial intelligence development.

stories.title: UPI transaction value exceeds 31.53 lakh crore
stories.summary: The Unified Payments Interface processed 25.47 billion transactions in October 2026, reaching a record value of 31.53 lakh crore. The National Payments Corporation of India noted that average daily transaction values also crossed 1 lakh crore for the first time. Festive shopping was cited as a primary driver.

stories.title: India and Brazil explore UPI-Pix payment corridor
stories.summary: Gustavo Henrique Rodrigues Pessoa has proposed building a UPI-Pix corridor to lower costs for small firms trading between India and Brazil. India's UPI processed 23.2 billion transactions in May 2026, while Brazil's Pix handled over seven billion transactions worth more than 3 trillion Reais during the same period.

stories.title: Olyv raises 6 million dollars in Series B funding
stories.summary: Fintech platform Olyv has raised 6 million dollars from Nippon Life India AIF Management Limited. The investment brings the company's total Series B funding to approximately 30 million dollars. The firm plans to use the capital to expand its platform and reach underserved consumers.

stories.title: ScanX launches stock screening platform for Indian markets
stories.summary: ScanX has introduced a market research and stock screening platform designed for Indian investors. The company states it is bullish on India's economic prospects and aims to provide financial tools for a growing base of financially literate users who value time and high quality services.

stories.title: Google lets users connect their Wallet to Gemini for personal finance insights - Finextra Research
Piyush Goyal proposes India-Egypt digital payment cooperation
stories.summary: Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal has proposed that India and Egypt collaborate on cross-border digital payments. Addressing the Egypt-India Startup Forum, Goyal suggested that fintech companies from both nations work together to develop solutions by linking India's Unified Payments Interface with Egypt's InstaPay platform.

stories.title: Understanding Reit payouts and tax implications
stories.summary: Real estate investment trusts are required to distribute at least 90 percent of their net cash flows to unitholders. These payouts, known as distribution per unit, can consist of different income streams, each subject to distinct tax treatments. The process is not as straightforward as it may appear.

stories.title: Financial planners emphasize cash flow over asset allocation
stories.summary: Financial life planners suggest that portfolios can unravel if disconnected from an investor's cash flow. While investors often focus on strategic asset allocation across equities and fixed income, experts argue that cash flow dynamics are equally critical to ensuring portfolios can withstand financial pressures.

stories.title: High Court rules on bank deductions from pension accounts
stories.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh High Court recently addressed a case involving a bank deducting loan EMIs from a retired employee's pension account. The dispute arose after a guarantor for a defaulted loan requested that the bank stop recovering outstanding dues from his monthly pension payments.

stories.title: Property valuations may diverge from house price indices
stories.summary: Homeowners tracking property values via house price indices may find the data does not reflect their specific investment. Factors including location, size, age and condition influence actual prices, while indices can be skewed by the specific mix of premium or budget properties sold during a given period.

stories.title: PFRDA relaxes NPS KYC rules for NRI seafarers
stories.summary: The Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority now allows NRI seafarers to use employment contracts or Continuous Discharge Certificates as address proof for NPS Tier I accounts. The rule change aims to assist seafarers who often lack conventional overseas residential documentation required for account opening.

stories.title: Credit bureaus offer quarterly free financial reports
stories.summary: India's four major credit bureaus allow borrowers to access one complimentary full financial statement every quarter. These reports enable individuals to track repayment histories and identify unauthorized accounts. Lenders update these records every fortnight to evaluate loan eligibility for credit cards and other financial products.

stories.title: Calculating the timeline for a 1 crore SIP goal
stories.summary: Building a 1 crore investment corpus through a systematic investment plan requires discipline and patience. The time required to reach this milestone depends on the monthly investment amount and the assumed annualised return rate. Compounding becomes more visible once the initial 1 crore target is achieved.

stories.title: Experts outline early retirement corpus requirements
stories.summary: Financial experts suggest that early retirement requires a corpus worth 200 times an individual's monthly expenses. Planning for financial independence involves calculating withdrawal strategies and investment approaches to ensure funds last for 30 to 40 years. The goal is to retire before the age of 50.

stories.title: Motor insurance rules change on December 15
stories.summary: Insurers must separately disclose premiums for third-party liability, occupant protection, personal accident, and vehicle damage starting December 15. The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India says this transparency aims to give vehicle owners greater flexibility in customizing coverage. Flexibility is now a requirement.

stories.title: KVS issues NPS guidance for government employees
stories.summary: The Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan has released a list of frequently asked questions regarding the National Pension System. The guidance covers qualification, nomination, and withdrawal rules for its teachers. These details are intended to provide clarity for government employees navigating the pension scheme.

stories.title: Tax rules for gold purchased in a spouse's name
stories.summary: Buying gold in a wife's name is legal, but the Income-tax Department evaluates the source of funds and the identity of the earner upon sale. Holding the asset in another name does not automatically determine tax liability. The tax office remains interested in the money trail.

stories.title: Estimated cost of raising a child in urban India
stories.summary: Recent reports estimate the cost of raising a child in urban India at 40 lakh to 45 lakh rupees by adulthood. This figure accounts for private schooling, healthcare, and higher education. The total is presented as a reality check for parents planning their long-term finances.

research.title: Between the Lines: Multi-turn Contextual Investment Advice Detection
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly power financial conversational assistants, detecting investment advice in natural language has become a critical regulatory and safety challenge. Unlike explicit single-turn recommendations, investment advice often emerges implicitly and progressively over. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: CFOs Meet LLMs
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Business sentiment is closely watched, but measurement is slow and costly: surveys reach a limited number of firms, arrive periodically, and take time to field and compile. We show that large language models hold the potential. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: NoLBERT-Calls: Reading Earnings Calls Without Hindsight
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Language models are now a standard tool for measuring what managers say on earnings calls, but the encoders behind these measures were usually pretrained on text from the same years a backtest covers. Holding out a. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Short Windows, Unmodelled Costs, Unknown Cutoffs: A Pre-Registered Evidence Audit of 91 LLM Trading Papers
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Papers on large-language-model (LLM) trading agents and alpha mining report Sharpe ratios that would be remarkable in any other part of empirical finance. We audit the evidence behind those numbers. Before coding a single paper we. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
